verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי מְּאֹ֑ד גָּדַ֣לְתָּ לָבָֽשְׁתָּ׃ ה֭וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵî Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay mə·’ōḏ gā·ḏal·tā lā·ḇā·šə·tā hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār
verses.literal: Bless the LORD O my soul - O LORD my God You are very great You are clothed with splendor and majesty

verses.original: עֹֽטֶה־ א֭וֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָ֑ה נוֹטֶ֥ה שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם כַּיְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ṭeh- ’ō·wr kaś·śal·māh nō·w·ṭeh šā·ma·yim kay·rî·‘āh
verses.literal: He wraps Himself in light as [with] a garment He stretches out the heavens like a tent

verses.original: הַ֥מְקָרֶֽה עֲ‍ֽלִיּ֫וֹתָ֥יו בַמַּ֗יִם הַשָּׂם־ עָבִ֥ים רְכוּב֑וֹ הַֽ֝מְהַלֵּ֗ךְ עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·qā·reh ‘ălî·yō·w·ṯāw ḇam·ma·yim haś·śām- ‘ā·ḇîm rə·ḵū·ḇōw ham·hal·lêḵ ‘al- kan·p̄ê- rū·aḥ
verses.literal: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above making the clouds His chariot walking on the wings of the wind

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֣ה רוּח֑וֹת מַלְאָכָ֣יו לֹהֵֽט׃ אֵ֣שׁ מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śeh rū·ḥō·wṯ mal·’ā·ḵāw lō·hêṭ ’êš mə·šā·rə·ṯāw
verses.literal: He makes the winds His messengers flames of fire His servants

verses.original: יָֽסַד־ אֶ֭רֶץ עַל־ מְכוֹנֶ֑יהָ בַּל־ עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ תִּ֝מּ֗וֹט
verses.transliteration: yā·saḏ- ’e·reṣ ‘al- mə·ḵō·w·ne·hā bal- ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ tim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: He set the earth on its foundations never . . . . . . to be moved

verses.original: כִּסִּית֑וֹ תְּ֭הוֹם כַּלְּב֣וּשׁ מָֽיִם׃ יַֽעַמְדוּ־ עַל־ הָ֝רִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kis·sî·ṯōw tə·hō·wm kal·lə·ḇūš mā·yim ya·‘am·ḏū- ‘al- hā·rîm
verses.literal: You covered it with the deep like a garment the waters stood above the mountains

verses.original: מִן־ גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְנוּס֑וּן מִן־ ק֥וֹל רַֽ֝עַמְךָ֗ יֵחָפֵזֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: min- ga·‘ă·rā·ṯə·ḵā yə·nū·sūn min- qō·wl ra·‘am·ḵā yê·ḥā·p̄ê·zūn
verses.literal: At Your rebuke the waters fled at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away

verses.original: הָ֭רִים יַעֲל֣וּ בְקָע֑וֹת יֵרְד֣וּ אֶל־ מְ֝ק֗וֹם זֶ֤ה׀ יָסַ֬דְתָּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rîm ya·‘ă·lū ḇə·qā·‘ō·wṯ yê·rə·ḏū ’el- mə·qō·wm zeh yā·saḏ·tā lā·hem
verses.literal: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place . . . You assigned for them

verses.original: שַׂ֭מְתָּ גְּֽבוּל־ בַּל־ יַֽעֲבֹר֑וּן בַּל־ יְ֝שׁוּב֗וּן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: śam·tā gə·ḇū·l·śa- bal- ya·‘ă·ḇō·rūn bal- yə·šū·ḇūn lə·ḵas·sō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: You set a boundary they cannot cross that they may never again cover the earth

verses.original: הַֽמְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ מַ֭עְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִ֑ים יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃ בֵּ֥ין הָ֝רִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ham·šal·lê·aḥ ma‘·yā·nîm ban·nə·ḥā·lîm yə·hal·lê·ḵūn bên hā·rîm
verses.literal: He sends forth springs in the valleys they flow between the mountains

verses.original: יַ֭שְׁקוּ כָּל־ חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י פְרָאִ֣ים יִשְׁבְּר֖וּ צְמָאָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yaš·qū kāl- ḥay·ṯōw śā·ḏāy p̄ə·rā·’îm yiš·bə·rū ṣə·mā·’ām
verses.literal: They give drink to every beast of the field the wild donkeys quench their thirst

verses.original: עוֹף־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׁכּ֑וֹן עֲ֭לֵיהֶם יִתְּנוּ־ קֽוֹל׃ מִבֵּ֥ין עֳ֝פָאיִ֗ם
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·wp̄- haš·šā·ma·yim yiš·kō·wn ‘ă·lê·hem yit·tə·nū- qō·wl mib·bên ‘o·p̄ā·yim
verses.literal: The birds of the air nest beside the springs they sing . . . among the branches

verses.original: מַשְׁקֶ֣ה הָ֭רִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָ֑יו הָאָֽרֶץ׃ תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע מִפְּרִ֥י מַ֝עֲשֶׂ֗יךָ
verses.transliteration: maš·qeh hā·rîm mê·‘ă·lî·yō·w·ṯāw hā·’ā·reṣ tiś·ba‘ mip·pə·rî ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā
verses.literal: He waters the mountains from His chambers the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works

verses.original: חָצִ֨יר׀ מַצְמִ֤יחַ לַבְּהֵמָ֗ה וְ֭עֵשֶׂב הָאָדָ֑ם לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת לְה֥וֹצִיא לֶ֝֗חֶם מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṣîr maṣ·mî·aḥ lab·bə·hê·māh wə·‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·ḏām la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ lə·hō·w·ṣî le·ḥem min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate bringing forth food from the earth

verses.original: וְיַ֤יִן׀ יְשַׂמַּ֬ח לְֽבַב־ אֱנ֗וֹשׁ מִשָּׁ֑מֶן פָּנִ֣ים לְהַצְהִ֣יל וְ֝לֶ֗חֶם יִסְעָֽד׃ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ לְֽבַב־
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin yə·śam·maḥ lə·ḇaḇ- ’ĕ·nō·wōš miš·šā·men pā·nîm lə·haṣ·hîl wə·le·ḥem yis·‘āḏ ’ĕ·nō·wōš lə·ḇaḇ-
verses.literal: wine that gladdens the heart of man oil that makes his face to shine and bread that sustains [his] heart

verses.original: עֲצֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יִ֭שְׂבְּעוּ אַֽרְזֵ֥י לְ֝בָנ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָטָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣê Yah·weh yiś·bə·‘ū ’ar·zê lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’ă·šer nā·ṭā‘
verses.literal: The trees of the LORD have their fill the cedars of Lebanon that He planted

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֭ם צִפֳּרִ֣ים יְקַנֵּ֑נוּ חֲ֝סִידָ֗ה בֵּיתָֽהּ׃ בְּרוֹשִׁ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ’ă·še·rō·šā- šām ṣip·po·rîm yə·qan·nê·nū ḥă·sî·ḏāh bê·ṯāh bə·rō·wō·šîm
verses.literal: where the birds build their nests the stork makes her home in the cypresses

verses.original: הַ֭גְּבֹהִים הָרִ֣ים לַיְּעֵלִ֑ים סְ֝לָעִ֗ים מַחְסֶ֥ה לַֽשְׁפַנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gə·ḇō·hîm hā·rîm lay·yə·‘ê·lîm sə·lā·‘îm maḥ·seh laš·p̄an·nîm
verses.literal: The high mountains are for the wild goats the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers

verses.original: עָשָׂ֣ה יָ֭רֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִ֑ים שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ יָדַ֥ע מְבוֹאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śāh yā·rê·aḥ lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏîm meš yā·ḏa‘ mə·ḇō·w·’ōw
verses.literal: He made the moon to mark the seasons the sun knows when to set

verses.original: תָּֽשֶׁת־ חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וִ֣יהִי לָ֑יְלָה בּֽוֹ־ כָּל־ חַיְתוֹ־ יָֽעַר׃ תִ֝רְמֹ֗שׂ
verses.transliteration: tā·šeṯ- ḥō·šeḵ wî·hî lā·yə·lāh bōw- kāl- ḥay·ṯōw- yā·‘ar ṯir·mōś
verses.literal: You bring darkness and it becomes night when all the beasts of the forest prowl

verses.original: הַ֭כְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִ֣ים לַטָּ֑רֶף וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ אָכְלָֽם׃ מֵאֵ֣ל
verses.transliteration: hak·kə·p̄î·rîm šō·’ă·ḡîm laṭ·ṭā·rep̄ ū·lə·ḇaq·qêš ’ā·ḵə·lām mê·’êl
verses.literal: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God

verses.original: הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ תִּזְרַ֣ח יֵאָסֵפ֑וּן יִרְבָּצֽוּן׃ וְאֶל־ מְ֝עוֹנֹתָ֗ם
verses.transliteration: haš·še·meš tiz·raḥ yê·’ā·sê·p̄ūn yir·bā·ṣūn wə·’el- mə·‘ō·w·nō·ṯām
verses.literal: The sun rises and they withdraw they lie down in their dens

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם יֵצֵ֣א לְפָעֳל֑וֹ וְֽלַעֲבֹ֖דָת֣וֹ עֲדֵי־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām yê·ṣê lə·p̄ā·‘o·lōw wə·la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw ‘ă·ḏê- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening

verses.original: מָֽה־ רַבּ֬וּ מַעֲשֶׂ֨יךָ׀ יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ כֻּ֭לָּם הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מָלְאָ֥ה קִנְיָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: māh- rab·bū ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā Yah·weh bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh ‘ā·śî·ṯā kul·lām hā·’ā·reṣ mā·lə·’āh qin·yā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: How many are Your works O LORD In wisdom You have made them all the earth is full of Your creatures

verses.original: זֶ֤ה׀ הַיָּ֥ם גָּדוֹל֮ וּרְחַ֪ב יָ֫דָ֥יִם שָֽׁם־ רֶ֭מֶשׂ וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר חַיּ֥וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃ עִם־ קְ֝טַנּ֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: zeh hay·yām gā·ḏō·wl ū·rə·ḥaḇ yā·ḏā·yim šām- re·meś wə·’ên mis·pār ḥay·yō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ‘im- qə·ṭan·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Here is the sea vast and wide . . . . . . teeming with creatures beyond number . . . living things both great and small

verses.original: שָׁ֭ם אֳנִיּ֣וֹת יְהַלֵּכ֑וּן לִ֝וְיָתָ֗ן זֶֽה־ יָצַ֥רְתָּ לְשַֽׂחֶק־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šām ’o·nî·yō·wṯ yə·hal·lê·ḵūn liw·yā·ṯān zeh- yā·ṣar·tā lə·śa·ḥeq- bōw
verses.literal: There the ships pass and Leviathan which You formed to frolic there

verses.original: כֻּ֭לָּם יְשַׂבֵּר֑וּן אֵלֶ֣יךָ לָתֵ֖ת אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām yə·śab·bê·rūn ’ê·le·ḵā lā·ṯêṯ ’ā·ḵə·lām bə·‘it·tōw
verses.literal: All [creatures] look to You to give [them] their food in due season

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם יִלְקֹט֑וּן תִּפְתַּ֥ח יָֽ֝דְךָ֗ יִשְׂבְּע֥וּן טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên lā·hem yil·qō·ṭūn tip̄·taḥ yā·ḏə·ḵā yiś·bə·‘ūn ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: When You give it to them they gather it up when You open Your hand they are satisfied with good things

verses.original: תַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנֶיךָ֮ יִֽבָּהֵ֫ל֥וּן תֹּסֵ֣ף ר֭וּחָם יִגְוָע֑וּן יְשׁוּבֽוּן׃ וְֽאֶל־ עֲפָרָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: tas·tîr pā·ne·ḵā yib·bā·hê·lūn tō·sêp̄ rū·ḥām yiḡ·wā·‘ūn yə·šū·ḇūn wə·’el- ‘ă·p̄ā·rām
verses.literal: When You hide Your face they are terrified when You take away their breath they die and return to dust

verses.original: תְּשַׁלַּ֣ח ר֭וּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵא֑וּן וּ֝תְחַדֵּ֗שׁ פְּנֵ֣י אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·šal·laḥ rū·ḥă·ḵā yib·bā·rê·’ūn ū·ṯə·ḥad·dêš pə·nê ’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: When You send Your Spirit they are created and You renew the face of the earth

verses.original: כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֣ה יְהִ֤י לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְהוָ֣ה יִשְׂמַ֖ח בְּמַעֲשָֽׂיו׃
verses.transliteration: ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh yə·hî lə·‘ō·w·lām Yah·weh yiś·maḥ bə·ma·‘ă·śāw
verses.literal: May the glory of the LORD endure forever may the LORD rejoice in His works

verses.original: הַמַּבִּ֣יט לָ֭אָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָ֑ד יִגַּ֖ע בֶּהָרִ֣ים וְֽיֶעֱשָֽׁנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mab·bîṭ lā·’ā·reṣ wat·tir·‘āḏ yig·ga‘ be·hā·rîm wə·ye·‘ĕ·šā·nū
verses.literal: He looks on the earth and it trembles He touches the mountains and they smolder

verses.original: אָשִׁ֣ירָה לַיהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·šî·rāh Yah·weh bə·ḥay·yāy ’ă·zam·mə·rāh lê·lō·hay bə·‘ō·w·ḏî
verses.literal: I will sing to the LORD all my life I will sing praise to my God while I have my being

verses.original: שִׂיחִ֑י יֶעֱרַ֣ב עָלָ֣יו אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶשְׂמַ֥ח בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śî·ḥî ye·‘ĕ·raḇ ‘ā·lāw ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eś·maḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: May my meditation be pleasing to Him for I rejoice in the LORD

verses.original: חַטָּאִ֨ים׀ יִתַּ֤מּוּ מִן־ הָאָ֡רֶץ וּרְשָׁעִ֤ים׀ אֵינָ֗ם ע֤וֹד בָּרֲכִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm yit·tam·mū min- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·rə·šā·‘îm ’ê·nām ‘ō·wḏ bā·ră·ḵî Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eṯ- hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more Bless the LORD O my soul - Hallelujah . . .
